params.body:
The Insights page now shows current insights by default. Superseded ones (carried on by another insight) appear only when asked for.

Before, the index arrived with every superseded insight. "Hide refined" removed them from the list, but the status counts, the total in the header and the timeline still counted them. The pipeline now leaves them out unless `history` is passed (gentells-pipeline #360, merge that one first).

- `useInsightsIndex({ history })` and `useInsightSearch(q, { history })` pass it on, keyed separately in the cache.
- "Hide refined" becomes "Show superseded" (`?history=1`, `aria-pressed`). A history link opens with them in it. They are marked "superseded" and dimmed as before. The coverage stats, treemap, map and review queue keep reading current insights only, in either mode.
- Status counts skip superseded rows.

## Tests

The e2e mocks now behave like the pipeline: current only, unless the history is asked for. A superseded mock insight was added. New: left out by default, shown and marked after "Show superseded", and the `?history=1` link. 35 of 35 pass. Lint ratchet equal to the ceiling, build green.
params.title: Insights page: current insights by default, Show superseded for the history
